commands.help: Execute paged LDAP searches against Active Directory
commands.long_help: Performs LDAP queries against Active Directory using paged results. Supports custom filters, attribute selection, result limits, search scopes, and LDAPS. Uses current user credentials via Kerberos/NTLM negotiate authentication. Binary attributes like objectSid, objectGUID, and nTSecurityDescriptor are automatically decoded. This is the preferred LDAP search tool; use sa-nonpagedldapsearch only if paging is not supported.

arguments.name: attributes
arguments.desc: Comma-separated list of attributes to return (e.g., 'sAMAccountName,mail,memberOf'). Omit to return all attributes.

arguments.name: count
arguments.desc: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 0 (unlimited).

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Search scope: 1=BASE (single object), 2=ONELEVEL (immediate children), 3=SUBTREE (all descendants). Default: 3.

arguments.name: hostname
arguments.desc: Target Domain Controller hostname or IP. Default: auto-discovered PDC.

arguments.name: dn
arguments.desc: Distinguished Name for search base (e.g., 'DC=corp,DC=local'). Default: current domain DN.

arguments.name: ldaps
arguments.desc: Connection protocol: 1=LDAPS (port 636 with SSL), 0=LDAP (port 389 with signing/sealing). Default: 0.
